question: The author of 'Malgudi Days' is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Narayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RK Narayan** is a renowned Indian author known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.
 
• **'Malgudi Days'** is a collection of short stories that vividly portray the everyday lives of the people in Malgudi.
 
• RK Narayan's simple and elegant writing style has made his stories accessible and enjoyable to readers of all ages.
 
• He is one of the most celebrated Indian writers in English and has received numerous awards and honors for his literary contributions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• RK Narayan was born on October 10, 1906, in Chennai, India, and passed away on May 13, 2001.
 
• His full name is **Rasipuram Krishnaswami Iyer Narayanaswami**.
 
• In addition to 'Malgudi Days', some of his other famous works include **'Swami and Friends', 'The Bachelor of Arts', and 'The Guide'**.
 
• RK Narayan was awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in 1960 for his novel 'The Guide', which was also adapted into a successful film.
 
• He was nominated for the **Nobel Prize in Literature** multiple times but never won.
 
• In 2000, he was awarded India's second-highest civilian honor, the **Padma Vibhushan**.
